purpose: Collectible jigsaw-puzzle box-cover mockups for merch/gift-shop and licensed-IP puzzle products.
target_user: Collectible/merch sellers, gift shops, licensed-IP merchandise producers
content_gap: 拼图 (ZH) shows a stable, low, persistently-irrelevant result set (3 results) at every timepoint; the in-app UI shows a 'Generate this yourself' prompt for the English query, independently confirming the gap.

fixed_layout_structure: Puzzle box front mockup shown flat-on, occupying the full frame as the box face
Box cover art area (center ~65%) showing the puzzle's completed-image artwork
Brand/series logo band across the top (~12%)
Jigsaw-piece-cutout accent graphic in one corner (bottom-right), suggesting the puzzle format
Piece-count badge in the opposite bottom corner (bottom-left)
information_hierarchy: 1) box cover art (dominant) 2) brand/series logo 3) piece-count badge 4) jigsaw-piece cutout accent (smallest)
visual_style: Puzzle-piece-cutout product mockup with box cover art area, consistent with the existing 'mystery box' merchandise visual family already in-catalog
typography_direction: Playful bold sans-serif or display font for the brand/series logo; compact sans-serif for the piece-count badge
color_direction: Theme-coded palette matching the cover art subject (nature themes = greens/blues, travel themes = warm earth tones)
prompt_template: Design a jigsaw PUZZLE BOX cover mockup, {aspect_ratio} landscape aspect ratio, output size {output_size}. FIXED LAYOUT (must match across every variant of this template): the box front shown flat-on filling the frame; a large center cover-art area showing the puzzle's completed-image artwork; a brand/series logo band across the top; a jigsaw-piece-shaped cutout accent graphic in the bottom-right corner; a piece-count badge in the bottom-left corner. VARIABLE CONTENT for this specific example: cover art subject = {cover_art_subject}, theme = {theme_ip}, brand/series logo text = "{theme_ip} Puzzle Co.", piece-count badge text = "{piece_count}", palette = {palette}. Render the brand/series logo and piece-count badge as real, legible, correctly spelled text. Do not add a watermark.
negative_constraints: no stock-photo watermark text or agency logos
no extra/duplicate text blocks beyond the specified text_slots
no misspelled or garbled text -- render all specified text exactly as given, legible at output resolution
no meta-references (no 'template', 'placeholder', 'lorem ipsum', or design-tool UI chrome in the image)
no cropped or clipped subject at the edges of the frame
no low-contrast text over busy backgrounds -- keep all text slots on a readable, sufficiently contrasted zone
cover art must clearly read as puzzle box art, not a generic mystery-box design
piece-count badge text must be a plausible number (e.g. 500, 1000)
quality_criteria: jigsaw-piece-shaped cutout accent is present in the bottom-right
piece-count badge is present and legible
cover art matches the specified theme
